title: Integer arithmetic is exact in `NUMBER(38,0)`
verdict: never wraps; exact past 64 bits; the writer checks the 64-bit range
description: Every integer type (`TINYINT` … `BIGINT`, `INT`, `BYTEINT`) is `NUMBER(38,0)` (`int-type-names`), so `BIGINT` arithmetic has no 64-bit range: `9223372036854775807 + 1` is `9223372036854775808`, `-(-2^63)` is `2^63`, and `127::TINYINT + 1` is 128. Nothing wraps.
Past 38 digits a result is still kept up to 2^127 (see [decimal-arith](snowflake-decimal-arith.json), SF-1); past 128 bits it raises `Number out of representable range`.
reference: `add`, `subtract`, `multiply`, `negate` with `overflow: ERROR` at the declared width. sverify's SQL (`SnowflakeDialect.checked`) tests each result against the 64-bit range and raises outside it; literal operands fold at write time (`writer-int-fold`, `writer-int-fold-values`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT a + b AS r, SYSTEM$TYPEOF(a + b) AS t FROM (VALUES (9223372036854775807::BIGINT, 1::BIGINT)) AS s(a, b)

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
